premises.text: Existing braille interfaces are expensive, limited to a few words, and rely on bulky piezoelectric tech that contributes to low literacy among blind children
premises.evidence_span: it's a $5,000 up to $8,000 keyboard. And where a blind person can read, it's extremely limited to just a few words

premises.text: A high-performance membrane actuator controls and deforms each braille dot without mechanical elements, enabling thousands of dots
premises.evidence_span: we're using a high-performance membrane bonded to an electrical actuator

premises.text: A tactile tablet with braille screen plus touch/voiceover control lets blind users learn, work, and play on one device and output a full braille page
premises.evidence_span: the first tactile tablet for people with sight loss. It allows blind users for the first time to learn, work, and play with one single device

premises.text: Cloud conversion software turns text, documents, and web pages into braille for the tablet
premises.evidence_span: It can convert anything into Brow, like text files, documents, even whole web pages

premises.text: The device is offered at an affordable price of about $500
premises.evidence_span: with the affordable price of $500 US

premises.text: Go-to-market starts online, scales via global distributors, and expands access in developing countries
premises.evidence_span: we'll start directly to our website online. Moving forward, we're going to scale to global distributors

value.text: Accessible learn/work/play computing for people with sight loss via a full-page tactile braille tablet
value.evidence_span: allows blind users for the first time to learn, work, and play with one single device

secondary_value.text: Social mission to open modern tech access for millions of blind children
secondary_value.evidence_span: we can change the future of millions of children

causal_links.evidence_span: exactly this leads to low literacy rate among blind children
the digital e-reader for blind users
how we are going to bring the tablet to the hands of millions
